S3 — chat.message mutation injects a full TextPart canary
Run: 2026-10-06, model ollama/deepseek-v4.1-flash:cloud
Source: /tmp/pea-probe/out/probe.jsonl, S3.events.jsonl

probe.jsonl (injection performed with full TextPart shape — id, sessionID, messageID, type, text):
{"hook":"chat.message","ts":"2026-10-06T17:06:47.449Z","injected":"PEA-CANARY-1"}

Context: earlier runs crashed with
  SchemaError: Missing key at ["id"], ["sessionID"], ["messageID"]
when pushing a bare {type:"text"} part. Fix: build the part with
{id: "prt_"+Date.now(), sessionID: input.sessionID, messageID: input.messageID
(or output.message.id when input.messageID is absent in run mode), type:"text", text:CANARY}.
After the fix, no SchemaError appears in S3.stderr.log and the canary lands.

Model behavior note: the model refused to echo the full conversation verbatim, so
PEA-CANARY-1 does not appear in the model's own answer text in this run; the
injection is confirmed by the plugin's "injected" log line above (and in the
prior run the model's answer referenced "the `PEA-CANARY-1` line" it saw in
context — /tmp/pea-probe/out/S3.events.jsonl from run 16:57Z).
